## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or integration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `cd backend && python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build` passes (if the frontend changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they do not touch real `config.yaml`, `.env` or the database
- [ ] No secrets, resumes or personal data included
- [ ] Docs, `config.example.yaml` or `.env.example` updated if behaviour or options changed
- [ ] No em or en dashes in code, comments, docs or UI text
